newsitem.title: UK: Mutuality adds 15pct to bonuses-insurance boss.
newsitem.headline: Mutuality adds 15pct to bonuses-insurance boss.

text.p: Mutuality has added 15 percent to bonuses given policyholders, Michael Doerr, chief executive of insurer Friends Provident, said in a newspaper interview published on Monday.
"I think the record over the years bears out our contention that mutuals can earn a better return for their policyholders than proprietary companies," Doerr told the Independent newspaper.
"If we demutualise, the returns from fund management and non-with-profits business would all go into a separate shareholders' fund," he added.
